title: Sr. CSM (Logistics Tech)
description:
Portcast is a venture\-backed, Singapore\-based logistics technology company building AI\-powered intelligence for the freight forwarding industry. Freight forwarders manage thousands of shipments, rates, exceptions, and operational decisions every day. The challenge is not a lack of data. It is knowing what needs attention, what is going wrong, and what action to take next.



Portcast uses AI and data to help freight forwarders surface shipment exceptions, identify cost and margin risks, and make better decisions across the shipment lifecycle. Our products help teams improve operational efficiency, protect margins, and make faster, more informed decisions. Our vision is to become the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.



Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are a lean, globally distributed team building technology for an industry going through a major digital transformation.


**ABOUT THE ROLE:**
===================



We're looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to own our enterprise customer relationships end to end. Our CS team owns the full commercial relationship, strategic account management, adoption, renewal, expansion, and customer support, working directly with enterprise customers and their C\-suite. This is a senior individual\-contributor (IC) role for someone who can build trust and credibility at that level.



At the heart of the role is discovery. The best expansion comes from deeply understanding what each customer is really trying to achieve, where their pain sits, and how Portcast turns their data into decisions and measurable business impact. Strong discovery is what lets you deepen adoption, grow your accounts, and drive real revenue from your existing customers, through upsell, cross\-sell, and new teams and regions.



You'll also be technically fluent enough to be the customer's first point of contact on their questions and tickets, triaging the issue, working with our Data team to get the answer, and communicating a clear resolution back to the customer, all alongside the strategic work: QBRs, success plans, renewals, and expansion.

  


### **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:**


* Enterprise customers deeply adopt Portcast with measurable business outcomes, and see you as a trusted advisor at both the operational and C\-suite level.
* Discovery that consistently surfaces real customer needs and turns them into adoption, retention, and expansion.
* A steady expansion pipeline from existing accounts (upsell, cross\-sell, new teams and regions), with CS trusted, internally and by customers, to identify and drive those deals.
* Fast, credible resolution of customer questions and tickets, in partnership with the Data team, so customers always get reliable answers and stay confident in Portcast.
### **WHAT YOU’LL OWN:**


* **Own the full enterprise customer lifecycle:** onboarding, adoption, renewal, and retention, ensuring a smooth, high\-impact experience.
* **Lead discovery:** deeply understand each customer's goals, workflows, pain points, and internal decision processes, so you can grow the account and drive expansion.
* **Be a trusted advisor to enterprise stakeholders, including C\-suite,** aligning Portcast to their strategic goals and addressing their challenges.
* **Identify and drive expansion** (upsell, cross\-sell, new teams, new regions) in partnership with Sales, positioning CS as a credible driver of new revenue from existing customers.
* **Own customer questions and tickets:** triage the issue, work with the Data team to get the answer, then review and communicate a clear resolution back to the customer.
* **Run QBRs, success plans, and regular check\-ins,** using data, outcomes, and clear narratives to drive adoption and expansion.
* **Partner with Product, Data, and Engineering** to channel customer feedback and influence the roadmap.
* **Analyze customer usage and data** to surface actionable insights and continuously improve the customer journey.
### **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**


* At least 5\+ years in a commercial, customer\-facing role: Customer Success or Key Account Management role within the logistics industry or logistics technology space. An AE/sales or pre\-sales/solutions background is good to have.
* Strong discovery is one of the most important skills in this role, it's what lets you expand existing customers and drive new revenue.
* Logistics / logistics\-tech domain: familiarity with freight forwarding and global logistics workflows, and the ability to confidently engage customers across operations and commercial stakeholders.
* Comfortable with enterprise customers and their C\-suite, with strong stakeholder management across functions and seniority levels.
* Technical fluency: comfortable with basic data, APIs, and SaaS concepts, enough to handle customer questions and tickets, work with our Data team, and translate technical answers into clear customer\-facing resolutions.
* A track record of driving account expansion (upsell, cross\-sell) and revenue growth from existing customers.
* Experience running QBRs and structured account success plans, using data and outcomes to drive adoption and expansion.
* Excellent, structured communication, especially with complex, multi\-stakeholder enterprise customers.
* High ownership and independence, with the ability to operate in a lean startup environment and a bias for action.
* Bachelor's or Master's in Business, Logistics, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent.
### **WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**


* Work at the intersection of AI, data, and logistics: help enterprise customers turn predictive data into decisions and measurable business impact.
* Real impact from day one: we're lean by design, with few layers between you and the outcome, so your work moves adoption, retention, and expansion directly.
* Globally distributed, remote\-first flexibility: work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.
### **OUR CORE VALUES GUIDE EVERYTHING WE DO:**


* Curiosity: This is where discovery lives. We dig beneath what a customer asks for to what they're actually trying to achieve, staying genuinely curious about their business, their workflows, and how a freight forwarder really operates. That depth is where every expansion starts.
* Ownership: We act like founders. We own the customer relationship and the commercial outcome end to end, adoption, renewal, and expansion, and we stay on an account until the value is real and the number moves.
* Raising the bar: We don't settle for a renewed contract. We aim for customers who adopt deeply, expand with us, and become advocates, and we hold ourselves to that standard on every account.
* Effectiveness: We focus on the outcomes that matter, real adoption, retention, and revenue growth from our customers, not check\-ins or activity for their own sake. We prioritize the accounts and conversations that actually move the business.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

You are someone who looks at a test failure and does not just log it, you dig until you understand why it happened and what it means for the next release. Scripting is not a chore for you, it is how you make repetitive work disappear so you can focus on the problems that actually need a human brain. You have spent enough time in labs or codebases to know that quality is not something you test in at the end, it is something you build into the process from the start.


Data tells you stories. When you see a trend in regression results, you do not wait for someone else to notice, you pull the thread, ask the right questions, and surface what matters. You are comfortable working across teams, translating between what verification found, what design needs to know, and what a release checklist actually requires.


You do not need years of experience to have a point of view. You know when a process is not working and you are not afraid to suggest a better way. At Synopsys, you will work on Embedded Memory IP that powers the devices people use every day, and the rigor you bring to testing and automation will directly affect whether those products ship on time and work as promised.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Run kickoff and release meetings across design, verification, and release teams, making sure compliance checkpoints are hit and nothing falls through the cracks
* Execute regression testing on Embedded Memory IP, catch issues before they reach customers, and track results across release cycles
* Analyze test data to spot trends, recurring failures, and process gaps that affect product quality or schedule
* Write and maintain Python and Tcl automation scripts that eliminate manual testing steps and speed up validation workflows
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to align on quality gates, release criteria, and issue resolution timelines
* Document test results, failure analysis, and process improvements in a way that helps the next engineer understand what happened and why

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Ensure Embedded Memory IP on advanced process nodes ships with zero critical defects, directly affecting customer success and market readiness
* Reduce validation cycle time by automating repetitive test and data collection tasks, freeing engineers to focus on complex debug work
* Surface quality and process issues early in the development cycle, preventing costly delays and rework downstream
* Improve the reliability of regression infrastructure so teams can trust test results and make faster release decisions
* Strengthen compliance and traceability across the release process, reducing risk and audit friction
* Enable smarter decision\-making by turning raw test data into actionable insights for design and verification teams

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
* 2 years of experience in validation, testing, quality assurance, or a related engineering role
* Working knowledge of Python or Tcl for scripting and automation
* Ability to analyze data, identify patterns, and communicate findings clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Familiarity with regression testing, release processes, or quality management systems is a plus
* Strong problem\-solving instincts and the ability to work across teams without losing track of details

### **Who You Are**

* You can look at a spreadsheet of test results and spot the one anomaly that matters, not just the loudest failure
* You write scripts that other people can actually read and modify six months later
* You are comfortable running a meeting with senior engineers and keeping it focused without being intimidated
* When a process does not make sense, you ask why before you follow it blindly
* You can explain a technical issue to a release manager in two sentences without losing the nuance
* You stay organized when managing multiple release tracks, test cycles, and compliance checkpoints at once

### **Description**

  

We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD — the cross\-functional team accountable for delivering customer\-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The role sits at the intersection of engineering delivery and commercial commitment and is measured on how predictably the POD ships committed customer work on time, at the quality bar our clients expect, across multiple concurrent engagements.  

  

This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code — reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems — while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD's core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Delivery \& stakeholder ownership** — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* **Hands\-on technical leadership \& design** — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* **Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence** — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* **AI\-assisted engineering** — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* **SE \+ SQE leadership** — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* **People management \& culture** — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

 **Essential Skills \& Experience*** Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.
* Expert\-level hands\-on proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 through C\+\+20\) — able to review and write production\-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance.
* Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high\-performance, mission\-critical, low\-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading\-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks.
* Proven track record delivering complex, customer\-committed software projects in an Agile environment — working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows — and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don't, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.
* Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar).
* Demonstrated success as a people manager — growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations — with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers.

**Desirable Skills \& Experience*** Prior experience leading customer\-funded, professional services, or bespoke\-delivery engineering teams in a financial\-technology context, ideally on a major OMS/EMS/trading platform with exposure to Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, or trading UI.
* Familiarity with major exchange connectivity stacks (CME, ICE, Eurex, LSE, NSE, etc.) and with vendor certification / conformance testing, plus experience with formal CR / change\-management workflows in a regulated financial environment (Jira / Confluence for delivery tracking and design documentation).
* Working knowledge of Python for tooling, automation, and test scaffolding; familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, containerisation, and cloud technologies as applied to trading\-system delivery; background in kernel\-bypass / low\-latency networking (Solarflare, Onload) or lock\-free data structures.
* Track record of driving measurable productivity gains through AI adoption in an engineering team — e.g., accelerating design, code generation, code review, test coverage, or production triage — including establishing guardrails, prompts/skills libraries, and adoption metrics.

  

### **Benefits**

  

***Competitive Benefits \& Perks in India*** *We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance.*
* **Health \& Financial Security:**
	+ Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
* **Time Off \& Flexibility:**
	+ Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in\-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in\-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in\-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands\-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.
	+ 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days.
	+ One dedicated day per year for volunteering.
	+ Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development.
	+ An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years.
	+ Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal.
	+ Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents).
* **Work\-Life Support \& Resources:**
	+ Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment.
	+ Milestone anniversary bonuses.
* **Wellness \& Lifestyle Perks:**
	+ Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives.
* **Our Culture:**
Forward\-thinking, culture\-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion.

Trading Technologies (www.tradingtechnologies.com) is a global capital markets platform services company providing market\-leading technology for the end\-to\-end trading operations of Tier 1 banks, brokerages, money managers, hedge funds, proprietary traders, Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), commercial hedgers, and risk managers. With its roots in listed derivatives, the Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) company delivers “multi\-X” solutions, with “X” representing asset classes, functions, workflows, and geographies. This multi\-X approach features trade execution services across futures and options, fixed income, foreign exchange (FX), and cryptocurrencies, augmented by solutions for data and analytics, including transaction cost analysis (TCA); quantitative trading; compliance and trade surveillance; clearing and post\-trade allocation; and infrastructure services. The award\-winning TT platform ecosystem also helps exchanges deliver innovative solutions to their market participants and technology companies to distribute their complementary offerings to Trading Technologies’ clients.  

Trading Technologies is backed by leading global investment firms Thoma Bravo, one of the world’s largest and most experienced software investors, and 7Ridge, a global growth equity firm focused on technology\-enabled businesses.
This investment supports Trading Technologies’ continued focus on product innovation, platform scalability, and long\-term growth for customers and partners worldwide.
  

*Trading Technologies (TT) is an equal\-opportunity employer. Equal employment has been, and continues to be, a required practice at the Company. Trading Technologies’ practice of equal employment opportunity is to recruit, hire, train, promote, and base all employment decisions on ability rather than race, color, religion, national origin, sex/gender orientation, age, disability, sexual orientation, genetic information, parental status, veteran, or any other protected status. Additionally, TT participates in the E\-Verify Program for US offices.*  

  

### **About Trading Technologies**


Trading Technologies is a Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) technology platform provider to the global capital markets industry. The company’s award\-winning TT® platform connects to the world’s major international exchanges and liquidity venues in listed derivatives alongside a growing number of asset classes, including fixed income and cryptocurrencies. The TT platform delivers advanced tools for trade execution and order management, market data solutions, analytics, trade surveillance, risk management, and infrastructure services to the world’s leading sell\-side institutions, buy\-side firms, and exchanges. The company’s blue\-chip client base includes Tier 1 banks as well as brokers, money managers, hedge funds, proprietary traders, Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), commercial hedgers, and risk managers. These firms rely on the TT ecosystem to manage their end\-to\-end trading operations. In addition, exchanges utilize TT’s technology to deliver innovative solutions to their market participants. TT also strategically partners with technology companies to make their complementary offerings available to Trading Technologies’ global client base through the TT ecosystem.

title: Director – MES Practice Lead
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**

**Job Title:** Director – MES Practice Lead (Global Delivery Center India)

**Job Family:** Services Delivery / Digital Manufacturing (MES)

**Location:** Global Delivery Center (GDC)

**Reporting:** Reports to GDC Leadership; strong matrix alignment with Regional MES Practice Lead

**Purpose**


Lead and scale the MES Services business for the Global Delivery Center by building a strong MES competency, driving delivery excellence, and improving margins through standardization and templatization. This role partners closely with the regional counterpart to support growth, shape pipeline, and ensure successful execution for existing and new customers—while applying a strong **people\-first** leadership approach.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Practice \& Business Leadership**

* Own the GDC MES practice roadmap aligned with global/regional MES strategy.
* Define and manage the practice operating model: engagement, delivery readiness, resourcing, capability growth, and knowledge management.
* Partner with regional MES leaders to align offerings, priorities, and execution approach.

**Program Leadership (Leading from the Front)**

* Lead large and complex MES programs “from the front” with strong ownership of outcomes, stakeholder alignment, and execution rigor.
* Set the bar for execution excellence across program management, solution delivery, and customer communication.

**Delivery Excellence \& Governance**

* Establish and enforce project governance across MES programs (scope, schedule, risk, quality, and stakeholder management).
* Ensure consistent delivery standards, templates, and quality gates across all projects.
* Provide leadership for escalations, enable corrective actions, and institutionalize lessons learned.

**Standardization, Templatization \& Margin Improvement**

* Build and maintain reusable assets (delivery playbooks, templates, accelerators, estimation models, reference architectures).
* Drive productivity and margin improvements by increasing reuse and reducing delivery variability.
* Track and improve practice KPIs (margin, utilization, schedule predictability, quality, CSAT).

**MES Competency Development (Capability Building)**

* Develop MES techno\-functional capability across architecture, configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and hyper care.
* Define skill matrices, learning paths, certifications, mentoring plans, and succession pipeline.
* Establish communities of practice and continuous improvement mechanisms across delivery teams.

**People Leadership (People First)**

* Lead, coach, and mentor practice leaders, project managers, architects, and delivery teams.
* Build a high\-performing culture with strong engagement, accountability, and career growth.
* Drive performance management, talent development, and retention initiatives.

**Customer Engagement \& Pipeline Growth**

* Engage with existing customers to strengthen relationships, improve satisfaction, and expand scope/footprint.
* Support pre\-sales with discovery workshops, solution shaping, proposals, estimations, risk reviews, and delivery strategy.
* Drive pipeline growth in partnership with sales and regional MES leadership.

**Qualifications / Experience**

* **Minimum 15\+ years of experience in MES Services**, including end\-to\-end delivery ownership and services leadership.
* Proven experience **leading large MES programs from the front** (multi\-site / multi\-geography programs preferred), including go\-live leadership and executive stakeholder management.
* Strong MES techno\-functional expertise with end\-to\-end delivery ownership.
* Demonstrated success in improving margins via standardization, templatization, and governance.
* Strong executive stakeholder management, communication, and customer\-facing leadership.
* Track record of building and scaling competencies, teams, and delivery leaders.

**Critical Skills**

* Excellent people management and coaching capability; strong “people\-first” mindset.
* Practice leadership: operating model, governance, metrics, delivery excellence.
* Business acumen: profitability/margins, utilization, productivity, pipeline contribution.
* Collaboration: strong partnership with regional counterpart and cross\-functional teams.
* Customer engagement: credibility to lead workshops, escalations, and value discussions.

**Preferred Qualifications**


AVEVA platform experience preferred, with demonstrated exposure to delivering MES solutions leveraging AVEVA technologies (e.g., AVEVA MES / related AVEVA digital manufacturing ecosystem).

**What Success Looks Like**

* A scalable MES delivery model with strong governance and predictable outcomes.
* Measurable margin improvement through reuse and delivery standardization.
* Strong MES competency/bench with clear career paths and reduced key\-person dependency.
* Increased pipeline and expanded customer footprint through proactive engagement.
* High team engagement, retention, and leadership bench strength.

 **India Benefits include:**


Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well\-being support


It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.

  

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/

 **Hybrid working**


We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on\-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office\-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.

 **Hiring process**


Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.

  

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring\-process

AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting\-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.

  

We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability\-report.aveva.com/
